title: NILS stack manifest (stacks.json)
description: The stacks layout (record 43 S2, D9's stack work unit for tools that read DICOM): /input/stacks.json names every stack of the run with its files, each under a source place mounted read-only at /source/<n>, and for a multi-frame file the frames that are the stack's. Nothing is converted or copied.

rows.description: Record 55 D3: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.rows. The registry's rows a header model reads, for the run's stacks (scored true) and the other MR stacks of their sessions (scored false, read and never scored; a stack of a sample sealed now is listed only where it is the run's own)

votes.description: The names of a vote's fields, in order: axis, rule_set, rule, clause, value, tier, restates, as nils classify votes writes them

stacks.description: By stack id: whether it is scored, its whole fingerprint row (less its keys, its bookkeeping and the acquisition's date and time) and its votes

series.description: By series id: the sha256 of its frame of reference UID, so stacks of one frame are known as such and no UID is given, and its private elements as the digest read them

context.description: Record 55 E2, P1b: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.geometry. The other stacks of each session the run holds part of, read and never scored, so a pipeline that reads a stack against its session (the few-slice student's height against the session's top) reads the same input whether the run holds the whole session or a part of it (a --chunk page, a selection that is not whole studies). Each is MR (its own modality, else its fingerprint's) and not sealed now; empty when the run holds whole sessions. No path is given: a context stack is not mounted

modality.description: The stack's modality, else its fingerprint's

series_id.description: Record 55 E3: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.contrast. The stack's series, so a pipeline counts a session's series

header.description: Record 55 E3: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.contrast, as a stack of the run carries it

contrast.description: Record 55 E3: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.contrast, as a stack of the run carries it

files.description: Each of its files once, in the order a stack's files are listed, with only its geometry

orientation.description: Record 43: the stack's orientation as the registry derived it, such as axial

body_part.description: Record 43: the stack's body_part as the registry holds it now, or null where it has none

technique.description: Record 43: the stack's technique as the registry holds it now, or null

slices.description: Record 43: how many slices the files hold in order: one per single-frame file and the listed frames of a multi-frame file, so a pipeline picks slices without reading every header

header.description: Record 50: present on every stack only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.header, so a pipeline reads the facts the registry derived from the headers without reading them again

fingerprint.description: These columns of the stack's fingerprint row, each null where the row holds none; null when the stack has no fingerprint row

classification.description: Every classification row of the stack, by axis: a list per axis, several rows for a multi-valued axis and one row with a null value for an axis decided to nothing

batch.description: The name of the ingest batch that first brought the stack in, or null

cohorts.description: The names of the cohorts the stack's subject is an open member of, sorted

datasets.description: Record 55 E3: present only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.contrast. The names of the datasets (the source places) that hold a file of the stack, sorted

contrast.description: Record 55 E3: present on every stack and every context entry only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.contrast: the session facts the post-contrast model reads of the stack, from its series and its fingerprint, each null where the registry holds none. The date and time stay in the run's input and are never written out

contrast_bolus_agent.description: ContrastBolusAgent of the stack's series, as written

other_tag.description: Whether another contrast field of the series is filled: the route, a volume, a total dose or a flow rate above zero, or a start time

acquisition_date.description: The stack's earliest acquisition date (the fingerprint's), else its series' date, YYYY-MM-DD

acquisition_time.description: The stack's earliest acquisition time (the fingerprint's), else its series' time, HH:MM:SS with a fraction or none

mr_acquisition_type.description: 2D or 3D, as the fingerprint holds it

derived.description: Whether the fingerprint's ImageType says DERIVED

angio_flag.description: AngioFlag as the fingerprint holds it

text_all_ci.description: The fingerprint's folded, lower-cased text of the series' names

post_contrast_rules.description: The post_contrast rules whose evidence the stack's classification holds, sorted

geometry.description: Record 55 E2: present on every stack only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.geometry, beside each file's own geometry, so a pipeline chooses which frames to read without reading a header first. Each member is null where the registry holds none

image_orientation_patient.description: The direction cosines of the stack's rows and columns, ImageOrientationPatient as the stack's own images give it

slice_thickness.description: The slice thickness of the stack's fingerprint row, in mm; null for a stack not fingerprinted

spacing_between_slices.description: The spacing between slices of the stack's fingerprint row, in mm; null for a stack not fingerprinted

study.description: The study the stack's series is part of, as an id to group a session's stacks by, and nothing else: it names no study outside this registry

image_type.description: ImageType as the stack's own images give it, DICOM's backslash list as read

sop_class_uid.description: The SOP class of the stack's fingerprint row; null for a stack not fingerprinted

n_instances.description: How many instances the registry holds of the stack

sealed.description: Whether the stack is in a sample sealed now (record 48): a pipeline leaves it out of its session and answers it as sealed

frames.description: The frames of a multi-frame file that are this stack's, from one, as ranges (1-4,9); null for every frame

geometry.description: Record 55 E2: present on every file only when the descriptor sets x-nils.input.geometry: the file's own geometry as the registry read it from its header, each member null where it holds none. A multi-frame file's position is its first frame's; a pipeline reads the other frames' positions from the file

image_position_patient.description: ImagePositionPatient: where the image's first pixel sits, in mm

pixel_spacing.description: PixelSpacing: the spacing of rows, then of columns, in mm

number_of_frames.description: NumberOfFrames of the whole file; null for a file that does not say, which is one frame

identity.description: Record 55 E5: present on every file only when the descriptor declares the slice cache (x-nils.cache). The file's DICOM identity, by which the slice cache keys what a model read of it, never a registry id

sha256.description: The sha256 of the file's bytes, where a run reported reading it whole (results.json read) and the file still has the size and time it had then, on the disk and in the registry; null otherwise, and then the file is read

identity.description: Record 55 E5: present on every stack only when the descriptor declares the slice cache (x-nils.cache)

study_instance_uid.description: The StudyInstanceUID of the stack's session, by which the slice cache groups its entries per session
